title: Make the sounds people play on Beeper
content: Sell sample packs, effect presets and visualizers on beeper.buzz. Buyers load them straight into the Beeper app: on the pads, in the effects rack and behind the music.

settings.hint: Tap a pad to play it

title: You keep 70% of every sale
content: The share is of the price the buyer paid after discounts. Earnings become payable 14 days after the order completes, and refunded orders don't count. Payouts are sent by hand for now, to the payout email support keeps on file for you: contact hello@beeper.buzz to set it.

items.title: Sample packs
items.body: Up to 16 one-shots or loops, each mapped to a pad, a key zone or both. They load straight into the Sampler and work offline once downloaded.

items.title: Effect presets
items.body: Settings for the app's nine effects: drive, crush, EQ, chorus, phaser, echo, reverb, pump and compressor. One tap applies the whole chain.

items.title: Visualizers
items.body: A GLSL shader with up to eight parameters, driven by the bass, mids, highs and the beat, or a 3D scene in glTF. You preview it live in the browser while you build it.

items.title: Apply
items.body: Send a few examples of your work with your application.

items.title: Build
items.body: Once approved, make products in the creator studio: upload files, map samples to pads, set a price.

items.title: Submit
items.body: Send each product for review. We listen to it, check it loads in the app and put it live.

items.title: Get paid
items.body: Buyers download it into the Beeper app. You see every sale and get paid from your balance.

title: In the marketplace now
content: Made by creators, playable in the app today.

items.question: What does it cost to sell?
items.answer: Nothing up front. Beeper keeps 30% of the price the buyer paid after discounts, and you keep 70%.

items.question: Who sets the price?
items.answer: You do, per product, from $0.50 to $999.

items.question: When do I get paid?
items.answer: Earnings become payable 14 days after the order completes. Payouts are sent by hand for now, to the payout email support keeps on file for you.

items.question: Can I change a product after it's live?
items.answer: Yes. Name, description, price and categories change straight away. New files or preview media go back through review before buyers get them.

items.question: Who reviews my products?
items.answer: We do. We listen to every product, check that it loads in the app and then put it live.

title: Your sounds, on every Beeper
content: Applying takes a few minutes. You'll need a Beeper account.
